pr_title: Port diagnostic for certs with ephemeral keys on Windows to S.N.Q
pr_body:
Fixes #92721.

This ports logic from #83436 to System.Net.Quic.

Main changes are in MsQuicConfiguration and System.Net.Quic.csproj.

While implementing, I noticed that there is duplicated logic in TestHelper.cs and Configuration.Certificates.Dynamic.cs so I got rid of the one in TestHelper.

review_comments: Why do we need to duplicate?

This is the same logic as in SslStream. I assume the reason for that is that the Interop stub for `CertGetCertificateContextProperty` takes `SafeCertContextHandle`, but the `X509Certificate2.Handle` property returns an `IntPtr`. This is probably the easiest path to call that function, given that it's on slow/exceptional path anyway.
